title: I yelled tactics at an AI and it made 11 little card guys play football exactly how I described. I have not slept.
author: hojajunixar
selftext:
browser game(aiworldcup.game). you build a football team out of cards, then instead of playing it you just… tell an AI how you want them to play. plain english. "press high, feed the right winger, don't get caught on the counter." it turns your rant into an actual game plan and the little guys go do it.

the cursed part: it works. described a high-press team, described a park-the-bus team, made them play each other, and they BOTH stuck to character like method actors. one pressed like its life depended on it, the other sat back smirking.

now I'm just sitting here describing increasingly unhinged tactics to see what breaks it. "everyone stand on the left." "only the goalkeeper is allowed to be brave." send help.
